items.claim: Le is 6'5" and cuts down to the heavyweight limit, giving him a 40 to 50 pound weight advantage.
items.quote: this guy, Leaka, is is all of 6'5. He's cutting to 265... Le is probably going to have like a 40 to 50 lb advantage here

items.claim: Le has a ton of power on the feet.
items.quote: he's a good fighter. He has a ton of power on the feet.

items.claim: Popic has a speed advantage because Le is pretty slow standing.
items.quote: Popic is going to have a speed advantage here for sure cuz Le is pretty slow when the fight standing

items.claim: Popic has been taken down and held down by light heavyweights and middleweights.
items.quote: I've seen Popic taken down and held down by light heavyweights, by middleweights

items.claim: Le has really good control and ground and pound once he gets an opponent on top.
items.quote: Le when he gets on top, he does have really good control. You're not getting up if this guy takes you down. He has really good ground and pound.

items.claim: Mateusz Rebecki holds a win over Myktybek Orolbai.
items.quote: the win is against Myktybek Orolbai... and he beat him.

items.claim: Rebecki showed bad fight IQ by grappling with Grant Dawson.
items.quote: he had a tough fight against Grant Dawson where he did drop Grant Dawson but he showed bad fight IQ and grappled with him.

items.claim: Kyle Prepolec does not like pressure and borderline quit after being pressured by Drew Dober.
items.quote: I don't think Prepolec likes pressure... Prepolec was like didn't know what to do. He and then he borderline quit.

items.claim: Mateusz Rebecki fights with constant forward pressure 110% of the time.
items.quote: that's how Mateusz Rębecki fights. He's 110% coming forward the entire time, 110% pressure.

items.claim: Kyle Prepolec has around a 50% or lower takedown defense.
items.quote: He has like a 50% takedown defense if that. Let's say it's 45%

items.claim: Kyle Prepolec makes mistakes on the mat, gives up his back, and has been submitted multiple times.
items.quote: he's making so many mistakes on the mat. He's giving up his back. He's giving up bad positions. He's been submitted in multiple fights.

items.claim: Marina Spasic has a kickboxing background.
Spasic is a little low volume early on but has constant forward pressure and turns it up in the third round.
items.quote: A little bit low volume, you know, early on in the fight, but she has constant forward pressure the entire time... and then she really starts to turn it up in that third round.
